rows.title: 'The Infernal Affairs Trilogy' Blu-ray: The Criterion Collection
rows.comment: These restorations make the best of what they have
rows.verdict_le10: These restorations make the best of what they have
rows.dek_lead: Such inconsistencies are most apparent in the first Infernal Affairs, which is all the livelier for it, while the third film is the most polished. These restorations make the best of what they have, but they don’t appear to be definitive. T
